package_info.why_malicious: No malicious software package is described in this report. The article discusses a large-scale DDoS attack against Microsoft Azure clients, but does not mention any specific malicious code, software package, or malware sample.

behavioral_signatures: Unusually high volume of network traffic from diverse global sources
Sustained network traffic spikes targeting a single service or endpoint
Traffic patterns consistent with DDoS amplification or botnet activity
network_indicators: Traffic originating from tens of thousands of unique IPs across multiple countries
Sudden spikes in inbound bandwidth (e.g., >1 Tbps) to a single service
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for abnormal spikes in inbound network traffic, especially from a large number of geographically distributed sources. Use DDoS detection systems to identify and mitigate volumetric attacks. Correlate traffic patterns with known DDoS attack signatures and monitor for secondary attack attempts during DDoS events.
